name: Discover Hiring Companies
runs_on: a scraper payload, not a launch row: the Apify job-posts run's dataset, named by a Hub Signals row. POST /webhook/discover-hiring-companies {signal: <Hub Signals record id>, resource: {{resource}}, tag: <optional>} ('play' accepted as the signal key). The Signals row carries Client, Signal Type, Roles, Country, Max Employees, ICP; Table is implied (Companies)
launch_row: signal (Hub Signals record id, resolves the Client and its Clayroots base)
reads: the Hub Signals row and the Client row behind it; the client base's schema (Companies and the synced Signals mirror); the mirror row for this signal, by exact case-sensitive Name; the Companies rows at the scraped domains (Domain, Signals) twice, once to drop what already carries this signal and once to union the links; the DNC table, through the helper
creates: nothing of its own (allowNew false): the register's columns and the Hiring group must exist, or the helper refuses and nothing is written. The Hiring group is the 15 Job columns (Job ID, Title, Link, Posted, Description, Seniority, Function, Employment Type, Industries, Applicants, Salary, Poster Name, Poster Title, Poster LinkedIn) plus Existing In Role, Signals (link to the mirror), Signal At and ICP Reason
held_value: a company that signals again is updated in place: Signals links unioned never replaced, Signal At re-stamped, the Job payload and Existing In Role overwritten with the latest event, ICP Reason rewritten. An empty value is never written: on a held row every blank is omitted, so a signal never clears what a landing door wrote. Domain Source (Signal) on create only; Tag re-stamped when the payload carries one. A company whose row already links THIS signal's mirror row is dropped before any paid call
providers: Apify (the dataset read, three tries then a logged skip that closes the row Failed); DiscoLike bizdata, one call per company 4.5 s apart, a 404 is unknown and any other status a counted failure; DiscoLike validate/icp, one task for the whole list, BYOK, polled up to 20 times at 15 s, a missing verdict rejects the company and is logged; DiscoLike contacts/count for Existing In Role, free, a failed count is a named failure on the row. Every one continues on error and is counted; the log names it
logs: the one Hub Automations row, upsert on Execution ID, Client attached, Status computed (Failed when the source could not be read, Succeeded with errors when a provider failed): jobs in, the hard-line drops by reason, already-signalled drops, BizData matched/unknown/closed/errors, ICP yes/partial/no with every no's reason, first-hire split, rows formatted, the helper's created/updated/DNC/landed, the hand-off, skips, failures. A refused run writes the same one row, Failed, naming the payload or base field to fix
handoff: Enrich Contacts (PLTNYqqoYfrt9ypd), once, not awaited, one item {Client, Table 'Companies', View 'Not Sourced', Tag, Domains} and nothing else
